Select approved drugs (max_phase = 4) with an indication of 'pain'. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Join to atc_classification on level5 to filter by the ATC label 'pain'. Left join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id as indication_curie, efo_term as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
